description: Chocolate cake. Stresses the 'whisk the dry ingredients' / 'wet ingredients' abstraction that the regex matcher cannot resolve.
steps: Preheat the oven to 350F and grease two cake pans.
In a large bowl, whisk together the dry ingredients.
In another bowl, beat the eggs, then add the buttermilk, oil, and vanilla.
Pour the wet mixture into the dry and stir until just combined.
Stir in the hot coffee until the batter is smooth and pourable.
Divide the batter between the pans and bake for 30 minutes.
